title: Move last element to front of a given Linked List
description: Move the last node to the front of a linked list in O(N) time and O(1) space.

title: Add 1 to a number represented as linked list
description: Add 1 to number represented as linked list where each node contains a single digit.

title: Add two numbers represented by linked lists
description: Add two numbers stored as linked lists in reverse order and return sum as a linked list.

title: Intersection of two Sorted Linked Lists
description: Construct a list containing elements common to two sorted linked lists.

title: Intersection Point of two Linked Lists
description: Find node at which intersection of two singly linked lists begins in O(N+M) time and O(1) space.

title: Merge Sort for Linked Lists
description: Sort a linked list in O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space using Merge Sort.

title: Quick Sort for Linked Lists
description: Sort a singly linked list using quicksort partition on pointers.

title: Middle of the Linked List
description: Find the middle node of a linked list using slow and fast pointer approach in one pass.

title: Check if a linked list is Circular Linked List
description: Determine whether a given linked list is circular or null-terminated.

title: Split a Circular linked list into two halves
description: Given a circular linked list, split it into two circular linked lists each of half size.

title: Palindrome Linked List
description: Check if a singly linked list is a palindrome in O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

title: Deletion from a Circular Linked List
description: Delete a given node from a circular linked list preserving circular structure.

title: Reverse a Doubly Linked List
description: Reverse a doubly linked list by swapping prev and next pointers for each node.

title: Find pairs with given sum in doubly linked list
description: Find all pairs in a sorted doubly linked list whose sum is equal to given value X using two pointers.

title: Count triplets in a sorted doubly linked list whose sum is equal to X
description: Count triplets with given sum X in a sorted doubly linked list using two pointers on suffix.

title: Rotate Doubly linked list by N nodes
description: Rotate doubly linked list counter-clockwise by N nodes by reconnecting head and tail.

title: Rotate a Linked List
description: Given head of a linked list, rotate the list to the right by k places.

title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
description: Flatten a multilevel doubly linked list so all nodes appear in a single-level doubly linked list.

title: Sort a LL of 0s, 1s and 2s
description: Sort a linked list of 0s, 1s and 2s by changing links or count tracking.

title: Clone a linked list with next and random pointer
description: Deep copy linked list with random pointers in O(N) time and O(1) extra space by interleaving nodes.

title: Merge K sorted linked lists
description: Merge k sorted linked lists and return it as one sorted list using a Min-Heap or divide and conquer.

title: Multiply two numbers represented by Linked Lists
description: Multiply two numbers represented as linked lists modulo 10^9+7.

title: Delete nodes which have a greater value on right
description: Reverse list and track max value seen so far to remove nodes with greater values on right.

title: Segregate even and odd nodes in a Linked List
description: Group all even nodes followed by all odd nodes while maintaining their relative ordering.

title: Nth node from the end of a Linked List
description: Find or remove the nth node from the end of the list using two pointers spaced n nodes apart.

title: Find first non-repeating character from a stream of characters
description: Track first non-repeating character in dynamic stream using DLL and hash array.

title: Flatten a Linked List (bottom pointers)
description: Flatten linked list where every node has next and bottom pointers using recursive merge.

title: Sort a linked list that is sorted alternating ascending and descending
description: Split list into two sublists (ascending and descending), reverse descending one, and merge.

title: Delete without head pointer
description: Delete a node (except the tail) in a singly linked list given only access to that node.
